_comment: Pre-registered seed lexicon for the parked voice-negative-lexicon Phase 0 spike (brand-checkability roadmap 5.0). Frozen before the scan; plain case-insensitive word-bounded literal matching, no NLP. Corpus: the last 30 merged PR descriptions (title + body) and the last 100 commit messages on origin/main. Gate: >=5 distinct entries firing across >=10 items -> build; hits concentrated in <=2 entries -> schema field only; about 0 hits -> honest null.
